question: Which institute has been studying the Pensilungpa Glacier in Zanskar, Ladakh, to monitor its retreat and mass balance?

options.text: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology (WIHG)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology (WIHG)** is an autonomous research institute under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India.
